name: Zombie Touchdown
tagline: Zombies carry the flag and try to touch the humans' target; sides swap every round.
summary: Zombie Touchdown (December 2018) is an objective-based zombie mode. A flag-carrying zombie must touch (attack) the human faction's target object before time runs out while humans defend; zombies win on a successful touchdown, humans win by holding out, and the factions switch at the end of each round. Nobody is permanently dead - all players resurrect.
description: The wiki's in-game blurb: zombies hold the flag and touch the target of the human faction; zombie victory if the attack succeeds, human victory if they defend within the time limit; at the end of each round the factions are switched. Flags can only be carried by zombies, who can pass them using a skill; humans standing near a fallen flag can reset it to its initial position. All players can be resurrected without permanent death. The mode's ranking variant is played with a hero shop system. Compatible maps: Last Shelter (ztd_lastshelter_cso) and Checkmate (ztd_checkmate_cso).
rules: A flagged zombie must touch the human target object before the timer ends.
Humans defend the target for the duration; humans near a dropped flag can reset it.
Flags can only be held by zombies and passed between them with a skill.
Factions switch at the end of each round.
All players resurrect; no permanent death.
